For a 50-person Indian company, the main switching cost is usually implementation + employee adoption, not a large exit fee. Public pricing is limited, so treat these as quoted/custom-cost models rather than exact totals.

Provider	Cost model	Switching difficulty
ITILITE	₹0 platform fee; travel charged per trip/usage; no minimum commitment 
Itilite
	Low — self-serve platform, policies and approvals can be configured quickly
FCM Travel	Custom TMC/transaction pricing; corporate rates and negotiated inventory	Medium–High — more onboarding, traveller profiles, policy setup and account integration 
FCM Travel

American Express GBT	Custom TMC pricing; centralized billing can consolidate air spend	High — deeper TMC/billing integration; particularly relevant if using Amex's Business Travel Account 
americanexpress.com

Practical switching cost: budget roughly 2–6 weeks for a 50-person migration, mainly for traveller data, approval rules, GST/billing workflows, integrations and employee training.

For minimizing lock-in, check notice/termination period, implementation fees, minimum transaction commitments, data-export rights and whether unused credits are refundable before signing.
